sources.title: SinLlama - A Large Language Model for Sinhala - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract Low-resource languages such as Sinhala are often overlooked by open-source Large Language Models (LLMs). In this research, we extend an existing multilingual LLM (Llama-3-8B) to better serve Sinhala.
